utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks, Mara. I’m still sorting it out, but if you could bring some gloves and maybe a hammer, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, I’ll bring gloves and a hammer for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Eli, sorry I’m late—how’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: No worries, Dane. I’ve got it on my usual list, and I’m just waiting on the next clear step.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — do you want me to help with the next step?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I can help if you want me to bring anything by or check on the repair drive setup.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo — could you bring a roll of tape and check that the signup table is set up? That’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll bring a roll of tape and check the signup table setup.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me which repair tasks need attention first?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’d start with the roof leak and the broken porch step first—they’re the most urgent. After that, the fence and gutter work can probably wait a bit.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it—I’ll put the roof leak and porch step first, then circle back to the fence and gutters.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a little list going for the repair drive—what supplies do you still need?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m probably joining a bit late, but I can bring screws, tape, or a couple of basic tools. Just tell me what’s still on the list.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’d be a huge help—screws and tape are still needed, and a basic screwdriver would be great too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I might’ve missed the latest update, but I’m happy to help out if you need me.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Noah — I’m checking where they’re collecting the donations now, and I’ll let you know the exact spot.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Opal. I’ll keep an eye out and be ready when you do.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help however I can. What’s the repair drive need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s really kind of you, Rey. We need hands most for sorting donated tools and matching them with the right repair jobs.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can do that. Tell me where to start, and I’ll sort what I can.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’m a bit worried about the timing and who’s bringing what. If we sort the logistics first, I’ll feel much better.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That makes sense — I’ll sort the timing and make a quick list of who’s bringing what, then I’ll send it over to you.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that would really help. Once you send it, I can check for any gaps or overlaps.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, Oren, what still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I think the old lamps near the alley and that squeaky gate still need work. I should double-check my notes, though.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — can you check and tell me which one should we tackle first?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting a good turnout—Bo, is there anything you still need help with?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Maybe a hand carrying stuff over would help. I’m mostly set otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I can do that—just tell me where you want everything dropped off.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive’s been getting a nice little turnout so far — folks are dropping off tools and a few spare parts. I can swing by later and see what else they still need.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’s really kind of you, Tess. I’d appreciate it if you could check later and let me know what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, I’ll stop by later and get the latest. If they’re short on anything, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Hana — I can lend a hand or some tools for the repair drive. Just tell me what you need.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — can you tell me which tools you have on hand and when you’d be free to help?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got a drill, hammer, screwdrivers, and a wrench set, and I’m free this Saturday morning. Just let me know what to bring!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Rey, I’m hearing the repair drive’s coming together—want me to spread the word and see who can pitch in?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, that’d be great—thank you. I can help where I can, too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll get the word out right away and see who can help. I’ll let you know what I hear.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep track of where everything’s been dropped off for the repair drive. Just tell me the locations, and I’ll note them down.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Opal — thank you! I’ll start sending folks your way with the drop-off locations as I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great — I’ll keep a running list and make sure nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely—happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, thanks, Sam! Could you bring a sturdy pair of gloves and maybe help sort the donated tools when you get here?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course — I’ll bring sturdy gloves and help sort the donated tools when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So this repair drive is definitely happening, right? I just want to make sure I’ve got the details straight.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, it’s happening. I’ll send the details once they’re confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, thanks — I’ll wait for your confirmation before I tell anyone else.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll help keep the repair drive organized and make sure Sam gets the details.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Rosa — I really appreciate that. Just keep me posted on the details, and I’ll help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Will do, Sam — I’ll send you the details as soon as I have them, and thanks for being ready to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can use a few rolls of duct tape, some screws, and a box cutter if you’ve got one. I’ll keep track of what comes in and what we’re still short on.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’ve got duct tape and some screws, and I’ll check for a box cutter too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still planning to bring my old drill and a few extra screws for the repair drive. If you need anything else, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — that’s really helpful. I’ll pass it along if anyone mentions needing anything else.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll bring the drill and screws, and I’ll check back if I can help with anything else.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—just let me know the plan and where you need me.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Eli — that’s a huge help. I’ll send you the plan and drop-off time once I’ve lined up the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Faye—once you have it lined up, send it over and I’ll be there on time.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I can help out; just remind me what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Oren. I still need help sorting the donations and figuring out who can pick them up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing—I can sort the donations with you, and I’ll try to find someone who can pick them up too. Just point me at the boxes and I’m on it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll see if I can help with the repair drive, though I may need to keep it simple today.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Uli — what can you take on today?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help sort items and make a quick list, but I should keep to light lifting today.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds like the repair drive is really coming together—happy to help connect folks if you need an extra hand.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Oh, is it actually coming together? What’s still left to fix?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: A few things still need attention, but we’ve got a good start—mostly sorting tools, checking the busted lights, and lining up a couple more hands.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive’s coming together nicely—do you want me to keep an eye out for any updates while I’m out?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be great, thanks, Ira — I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course—I'll keep my ears open and let you know if I hear anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’ll have to work around the school run, but I can still help with the repair drive after that. Just let me know what time you need me.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’s great, Faye — after the school run should work fine. I’ll let you know the time, and I can bring the tools.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks Gus. Once you have the time, I’ll plan around pickup and be there after.
